action_input.code:
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Read the hero_power CSV
hero_power = pd.read_csv('csv/hero_power.csv')

# Filter for death touch power (power_id = 37)
death_touch_heroes = hero_power[hero_power['power_id'] == 37]

# Get unique hero_ids
hero_ids = death_touch_heroes['hero_id'].unique()

# Connect to the database and get superhero names
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/superhero.db')
query = "SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE id IN ({})".format(','.join(map(str, hero_ids)))
names_df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
conn.close()

# Combine results
result = names_df[names_df['superhero_name'].notna()]
print(result.to_string())
print("\nTotal count:", len(result))
